name: PeopleLooker

steps.text: Find your own record in the results (check the age, city and relatives), select it, and finish the site's steps. Then press "I've done this step".

notes: A BeenVerified-family site. Search, pick the record, solve an hCaptcha and confirm by email. privacy@peoplelooker.com takes requests if the form fails.
source: Process per redact.dev's PeopleLooker removal guide (updated 2026-08-05).
